name: @prjct.app/pi-doctor
description: Inventory of Pi packages and extensions: report what is unused, enable or disable extensions, clean leftovers and uninstall packages. Dry run by default; every change is backed up first.

scripts.test: export PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" PRJCT_HOME="$(mktemp -d)" && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check:immutable: ! grep -rn '\blet\b' src/ index.ts || (echo 'Use const and immutable values: no let bindings in src/ or index.ts' && exit 1)
